q: Exercise Dharma Guardian is held between India and which country?
x: Dharma Guardian = India–Japan army exercise. The 7th edition (2026) was in Uttarakhand. Asked in 2021 and 2025.

q: Who became India's Chief of Defence Staff in May 2026?
x: He is the 3rd CDS, after Bipin Rawat and Anil Chauhan.

q: Who is the present Chief of the Air Staff?
x: Ashutosh Dixit became the 29th CAS on 31 October 2026, after A.P. Singh.

q: KHANJAR 2026, held at Misamari in Assam, is an exercise with…
x: KHANJAR = India–Kyrgyzstan special forces (13th edition, February 2026). Kazakhstan = Prabal Dostyk; Uzbekistan = Dustlik.

q: AUSTRAHIND is a military exercise between India and…
x: India–Australia. The 5th edition was in Kerala from 19 October 2026.

q: Pralay, tested again in November 2026, is what type of missile?
x: Pralay is a DRDO quasi-ballistic surface-to-surface missile, tested from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha.

q: INS Aridhaman is India's ___ nuclear ballistic-missile submarine.
x: Arihant (1st) → Arighaat (2nd) → Aridhaman (3rd), all Arihant class.

q: The Navy's "Operation Urja Suraksha" (2026) was linked to…
o: Escorting ships through the Strait of Hormuz crisis
x: It protected India's oil and gas shipping during the 2026 Hormuz crisis.

q: SAREX-2026, the 12th National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise, was held off…
x: Organised by the Indian Coast Guard off Paradip in October 2026.
